Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Present for acknowledgements and fills (150=0, 150=1 or 150=2). Recommended mapping to FIX Tag 851 provided: 1st Character A = Trade Added Liquidity (851=1) R = Trade Removed Liquidity (851=2) C = Auction / Uncrossing (851=4) Added or Executed during an auction period. 2nd Character I = Added Hidden Liquidity that was price improved J = Added Liquidity NBBO Joiner K = Added Liquidity from the hidden (reserve) portion of an iceberg order S = Added Liquidity NBBO Setter O = Opening Auction or intra-day auction C = Closing Auction A = Halt Auction (Re-Opening) Match Trade Prevention (MTP) For participants that opt-in to Report MTP Fields functionality (at firm or port level), the liquidity add and remove values may be presented on an MTP triggered cancel/restatement. IMPORTANT: Trade Liquidity Indicator was Tag 9882 in the Chi-X Australia FIX specification. All Cboe markets use Tag 9730 for Trade Liquidity Indicator and Tag 9882 for Fee Code. For Auction Trades (1st character = C), the 2nd character will be populated as follows: • “O” Opening auction applies to standard 10:00 open, plus first day of trading auction for a new symbol • “C” Closing auction applies to standard 16:13 end of trading auction

Field.Name: BookingPurposeTrade

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: N = (default) indicates a new order. Y = Indicates an application level resend and is NOT SUPPORTED. For reasons of economy, Cboe does not track in primary storage the Cl Ord ID values of orders that are no longer live. For reasons of performance, Cboe does not access secondary storage to enforce unique Cl Ord ID values against orders that are no longer live. Without full duplicate Cl Ord ID value enforcement, it is not possible to safely implement the full behavior specified in the FIX 4.2 Protocol for Poss Resend=‘Y’. To remain economical, fast and safe, all messages with Poss Resend=‘Y’ will be simply ignored.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: For Trade With Price Improvement trade reports (Type ‘S’), the time the was Trade Capture Report initiated by the trading participant. For all other Trade Report Categories, the date and time the trading participant agreed to the off-market trade.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Ignored if: Trade Report Trans Type (487) = 1 (Cancel), and Trade Handling Inst (1123) = 1 (Two Sided Report).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill. Ignored if: Trade Report Trans Type (487) = 1

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: CXA Symbol.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: As At Date: Indicates date of the off- market trade referenced in the message in YYYYMMDD format. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade). Please note this is a mandatory field for type E, p, and t trade reports and should match the date specified in Transact Time (60), allowing for UTC to local conversion.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: F = Trade H = Trade Cancel (Two Sided Reports only)

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new or a cancellation. Unilateral trades reported under the service may not be amended by the participant. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Ignored if Trade Report Trans Type(487) = 1 (Cancel) and Trade Handling Inst (1123) = 1 (Two Sided Report). In that case use Trade ID(1003) instead. A leading tilde (~) cannot be sent on any Trade Report ID and will result in a reject. These are reserved for internal use by Cboe and could be received as a result of a system-generated Cross Id.

Field.Name: TradeLinkID
Field.Description: A unique identifier used to link Trade Capture Reports. This field is mandatory if Off Exch Trade Report Type(8181) = ‘P’, ‘p’ or ‘F’ and is used to link Trade Capture Reports that together comprise a multi-legged trade. The reporting participant is responsible for allocating this unique identifier. For all other cases this field is ignored. Maximum length is 10 characters.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: This field controls pending state of the trade report. 0 = (submit) for all new trade reports

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Used to specify a previously reported trade to be cancelled. This is the Trade ID(1003) generated by Cboe when the Trade Capture Report was accepted. Mandatory when Trade Report Trans Type(487) = 1 and Trade Handling Inst (1123) = 1 (Two Sided Report). Must be otherwise absent.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Used to specify trade reporting model used. 0 = Confirmed Trade 1 = Two Sided Report 2 = One Sided Report for Matching

Field.Name: ExecVenue
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Execution Venue to identify participant crossing system or dark pool –may be populated with MIC or ASIC allocated code. Maximum of 4 characters (additional characters will be ignored).

Field.Name: T1Settlement
Field.Description: The optional T+1 Settlement tag is only applicable to the Warrants Trade Report Facility. Both Participants must specify 8080=Y for T+1 Settlement to be report to CHESS. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (default ‘N’).

Field.Name: RemoveCrossingFromClearing
Field.Description: Instructs Cboe on how to process crossed trades with CHESS. Please contact Cboe Australia to confirm settings. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (default ‘N’).

Field.Name: OffExchTradeReportType
Field.Description: Category of the trade report. Must be one of the following: B = Block trade P,p = Large portfolio trade T,t = Large principal transaction S = Trade with Price Improvement L = Permitted trade during post trading hours period M = Permitted trade during pre trading hours period E = Out of hours trade X = Booking purpose trade F = ETF trade report – unit creation or redemption Using ‘p’ or ‘t’ for large portfolio trades and large principal transaction indicates that the trade subject of the report was done on the previous trading day and the participant has delayed the trade report as permitted in the Market Integrity Rules. One Sided Report for Matching Trade Reports may not use ‘S’, ‘P’,’p’, ‘E’, ‘F’, and ‘X’.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental identifier. 10 character alphanumeric. Spaces, symbols, or special characters are not allowed. Recorded and returned in Execution Reports. Available via FIX Drop.

Field.Name: ClientCrossRef
Field.Description: Can be used to provide additional client side cross reference information. Maximum length is 15 characters.

Field.Name: ShortSaleNakedQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of OrderQty (38) that is naked. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5.

Field.Name: ShortSaleCoveredQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of OrderQty (38) that is covered. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5.

Field.Name: ShortSaleLongQty
Field.Description: Defines the portion of OrderQty (38) owned by the participant who placed the order. It is assumed zero if it is not specified with a short sell order. Ignored unless Side (54) = 5. Order having Side (54) = 5 (sell short) will be rejected unless ShortSellNakedQty + ShortSellCoveredQty + ShortSellLongQty is equal to the OrderQty (38) and ShortSellLongQty < OrderQty (38).

Field.Name: OriginOfTrans
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Origin of Order (ex. ACN, ABN, CHESS HIN). Maximum of 20 characters.

Field.Name: IntermediaryID
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Intermediary Identifier–may be populated with AFS license number. Up to 10 characters in ASCII range 32- 126 are allowed.

Field.Name: DirectedWholesaleIndic
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field to identify wholesale client. Possible values: ‘Y’ or ‘N’ (default ‘N’).

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with execution. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Participant ID (required tag to start each repeated group).

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: C = Generally accepted market participant identifier

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Required parties for each Trade Report type. One each of: 7 = EnteringFirm 17 = ContraFirm
